note: Replay `seed` through initialize(agentId,{epoch,timestamp,...seed}) then each append step; `expected` is the store state after all appends and enrichments.

timelines.name: text_chunks_same_turn
timelines.description: Adjacent assistant chunks without messageId merge into the last row.

timelines.name: assistant_message_id_rules
timelines.description: Explicit differing messageId breaks the merge; undefined messageId merges into the previous row; same id merges.

timelines.name: turn_id_change
timelines.description: Same text kind with a different turnId (or absent turnId) never merges.

timelines.name: reasoning_merge
timelines.description: Reasoning chunks merge when adjacent and same turn.

timelines.name: tool_interleaved
timelines.description: Tool updates merge into the first row by callId; seqEnd of the first row is non-monotonic against later rows.

timelines.name: tool_same_callid_new_turn
timelines.description: Same callId under a different turnId starts a new row and takes the identity.

timelines.name: tool_detail_merge
timelines.description: unknown detail never overwrites a known one; known replaces unknown; metadata shallow-merges; error rules per status.

timelines.name: tool_error_semantics
timelines.description: failed sets error, completed/canceled null it, running keeps/overrides when present.

timelines.name: plugin_identity
timelines.description: Plugin items with the same pluginId/id replace the item but keep seqStart; other plugin ids stay separate.

timelines.name: non_merging_types
timelines.description: todo, error, notification and compaction rows never merge.

timelines.name: text_tool_text
timelines.description: Text separated by a tool row does not merge across it.

timelines.name: provider_message_id_enrich
timelines.description: Submitted user rows get providerMessageId via enrich; rows keep turnId/providerMessageId.

timelines.name: seeded_items_next_seq
timelines.description: initialize({items,nextSeq}) numbers seeded rows from nextSeq (imported agents).

timelines.name: seeded_rows_gap
timelines.description: Seeded rows start at seq 5: minSeq 5, so after-cursors below 4 are gaps.

timelines.name: long_multi_turn
timelines.description: Six turns mixing reasoning, tools and text; used for limit/paging matrices.
